about: Tracks and their stages in order (SPEC §4). stages.py reads this file; it never hard-codes the order.

full.label: Full production
full.when: A full piece of content: research, scenes and shots, elements built and locked one by one, then shots generated from them. Ends at approved finals; the DaVinci hand-off runs only when the user asks.

single.label: Single asset
single.when: One asset: an icon, a thumbnail, a single shot.

quick.label: Quick shot
quick.when: One shot straight to the real thing: one prompt card, one live price, one yes from the user, then generate, wait and download. No intake, no QA agents, no drafts unless asked.

refine.label: Prompt refinement
refine.when: The user only wants a prompt. Quick questions, then a prompt card. No generation at all.

about_on_request: Stages on this list start skipped on a new project and run only when the user asks for them (sc.py stage include <stage> --user-said "...").
